Watch: The market is clearly favoring some names over others, and your concentrated tech book is feeling it. Keep an eye on how the AI trade continues to split.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech positions are under severe pressure; focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or stopping out given the -55% PnL and leveraged decay. The stop is 200, but a tighter stop might be prudent.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is down significantly. Re-evaluate your stop at 21.38 or consider exiting.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
